item.tib: drin can bla ma'i sgrub pa las rgyan bkod skabs kyi las rim
item.coloph: ces pa'i skyabs gnas 'dus gtso drin can bla ma'i sgrab pa bsam 'phel nor bu'i 'phreng ba las/ rgyan bkod skabs kyi las rim 'di yang / mkhas pa rin chen blo gsal gyi rnam rol/ spyang 'phags rin po che mnyam med tshul khrims dbang grags gis bka' gsung spyi bor phab pa dang / ma zad rigs mthun grogs po brtse gdung gcig tu 'dres pa'i btsun pa tshul khrims blo gros kyis rten 'brel legs mtshon spyi blug dang dar dkar dri med kyis sna drangs nas bskul ba la brten nas/ tshe dbang bla ma'i rjes 'bring tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am gsang ba'i ming ni g.yung drung thog med rtsal du 'bod pa'i rgyal khams kyi khol po ba des dpal ldan nor bu gling gi ri khrod du drin can bla ma de nyid mdun du bzhugs par byas shing skyo gdung gi snang ba dang bcas nas spel ba'o//
